item.title: We Are Bama | The Crimson Tide through the eyes of 8 mm film
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
College football has changed, but at Alabama, some things remain timeless.
The winning. The Walk of Champions. Saturdays on the Quad. Legendary coaches and players. Rammer Jammer. Dixieland Delight.
We Are Bama looks back at the traditions that have connected generations of Alabama football, told through the look and feel of lost 8mm film and rediscovered by the next generation.
The names change. The game changes.
The tradition remains.
We are Bama

item.title: One-on-One with Alex Golesh: Auburn's new head coach details unique backstory, journey to the Plains
item.author: Auburn Tigers on AL.com
item.description:
Alex Golesh’s story begins long before he ever stepped on a sideline. From a unique upbringing to a humble rise in coaching, Auburn’s new head man details his journey from Russia to the Plains in an exclusive and expansive sitdown interview with @aldotcom's sports video team and beat reporter Peter Rauterkus.
AL.com media coverage presented by @gobuildalabama
Video produced and edited by Laura Goldman
For more from this interview, read Peter's story: https://www.al.com/auburnfootball/2026/08/the-making-of-alex-golesh-in-exclusive-interview-auburn-coach-details-unique-backstory-journey-to-the-plains.html

item.title: What was Auburn HC Alex Golesh like as a player? Interview with AL.com coming 8/30 @gobuildalabama
item.author: Auburn Tigers on AL.com
item.description:
Growing up playing and watching hockey in Russia, a young Alex Golesh was naturally drawn to football’s physicality.
What was Auburn’s new head coach like as a player? In an exclusive interview with AL.com, Golesh looks back on his early years in the sport — when his goal was to be “the most violent dude on the field.”
Full video: https://youtu.be/ICrp8v6iVTA?is=sb37_W31BT2X2qji
